display.purpose: Page-defining hero statement, one per view. Lora, light weight, near-collapsed leading, often uppercase.

headline.purpose: Major section openers. Lora, light weight.

title.purpose: Card titles, subsection and dialog headings. Inter semibold.

body.purpose: Default reading text at a 65-75ch measure. Inter regular, 1.6 leading.

label.purpose: Uppercase metadata, eyebrows, category tags, table headers. Inter medium, 0.017em tracking.

shadows.name: ambient-sm
shadows.purpose: Open overlays only (dropdown, popover, modal) and the special button variant. Never on a resting card.

shadows.name: input-inset
shadows.purpose: Text field at rest; removed on group hover and focus.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-in reveals (fade/slide), opacity plus small translate only.

motion.name: input-glow
motion.purpose: Cursor-tracking clay radial wash on input hover.

motion.name: gradient-drift
motion.purpose: Slow ambient background-gradient loop on select hero backdrops.

motion.name: flow-line
motion.purpose: Dashed stroke march on automation/workflow diagrams (the one sanctioned decorative motion).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action. Slate-dark fill, ivory text, flat 150ms transition, clay focus ring. No hover lift or shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 12px 32px; background: #141413; color: #FAF9F5; font-family: Inter, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3D3D3A; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FAF9F5, 0 0 0 4px #D97757; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: The one warm CTA. Clay fill, ivory text, identical in light and dark. Use for the single most important action in view.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 12px 32px; background: #D97757; color: #FAF9F5; font-family: Inter, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #C6613F; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FAF9F5, 0 0 0 4px #D97757; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action. Transparent fill, hairline slate border, fills oat on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 12px 32px; background: transparent; color: #141413; font-family: Inter, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,19,0.25); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #E3DACC; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FAF9F5, 0 0 0 4px #D97757; }

components.name: Editorial Card
components.description: Release / article card. Oat fill, 16px radius, flat at rest, meta row divided by a top hairline with uppercase labels.
components.html:
Automatización de facturas

Extrae, valida y archiva cada factura sin intervención manual.

Caso de uso5 min
components.css: .ds-card-editorial { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 32px; background: #E3DACC; color: #141413; border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,19,0.10); border-radius: 16px; } .ds-card-editorial__title { margin: 0; font-family: Inter, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.005em; } .ds-card-editorial__body { margin: 0; font-family: Inter, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.6; color: #3D3D3A; } .ds-card-editorial__meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(20,20,19,0.10); font-family: Inter, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.017em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #87867F; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Oat fill, borderless, soft inset at rest, clay focus ring. A clay radial wash tracks the cursor on hover.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { padding: 2px; border-radius: 12px; transition: background 300ms ease; } .ds-input-wrap:hover { background: radial-gradient(100px circle at 50% 50%, rgba(217,119,87,0.18), transparent 80%); } .ds-input { display: flex; height: 40px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; background: #E3DACC; color: #141413; font-family: Inter, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 2px 3px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.10), 0 1px 0 0 rgba(25,28,33,0.02), 0 0 0 1px rgba(25,28,33,0.08); transition: box-shadow 400ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #87867F; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #D97757; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #D97757; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Fully rounded pill, hairline border, semibold micro-type. Slate-dark default; ivory-medium secondary.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; background: #141413; color: #FAF9F5; font-family: Inter, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-badge--secondary { background: #F0EEE6; color: #141413; }

components.name: Uppercase Label
components.description: Metadata / eyebrow text. Inter medium, uppercase, 0.017em tracking, cloud-dark on warm ground.
components.css: .ds-label { font-family: Inter, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.017em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #87867F; }

narrative.overview:
Ordinaly builds AI automation for businesses and trains their teams to run it. The interface should feel like the workspace of a craft-house that happens to work in software: warm, sunlit, unhurried, and exact. The palette is drawn from sevillano light and material - bleached ivory walls, oat linen, the terracotta of a clay tile - with near-black slate as the ink. Regional character is the quiet differentiator: not folklore, but the calm confidence of a studio that has been doing careful work for a long time.

The system is editorial and disciplined. Hierarchy is carried by a serif display voice against a clean Inter body, by generous whitespace, by uppercase metadata labels, and by hairline rules - not by color noise or ornament. One accent (clay) does the highlighting work, and it earns its rarity. Surfaces are flat; depth comes from layering the warm neutrals, not from shadow. Motion is short, eased, and functional.

This world explicitly rejects the generic AI-startup look - purple-to-blue gradients, glowing orbs, neon grids, dark-mode hero drama - and it rejects glow and neon effects as a system style. A small number of service landing pages use glow-* utilities locally; those are surface-local exceptions, not system doctrine.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral ground (ivory / oat), near-black slate ink, single clay accent.
Serif display (Lora) for the big statements; Inter for everything operational.
Flat surfaces, depth by tonal layering of neutrals.
Uppercase, wide-tracked labels for metadata and eyebrows.
Short functional motion (150ms state, ~300ms reveal); no bounce, no pulse.
Bilingual ES/EN - layouts must absorb ~25% text expansion.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Clay covers <=10% of any screen. It marks the one thing that matters most in view - a primary action, a focus ring, a live eyebrow. Two clay elements competing for attention on the same screen is a defect.

rules.name: The Warm Ground Rule
rules.body: Every background is a neutral from the ivory/oat/slate ramp. Pure white (#FFFFFF) and pure black appear only inside the deliberate featured-hero treatment, never as a page or card ground.

rules.name: The Legacy Palette Rule
rules.body: Purple #623CEA and teal #46B1C9 are removed - the purple and blue keys are gone from tailwind.config.ts and every usage was remapped (purple -> clay, teal -> cobalt). Do not reintroduce them. The green Tailwind key is misnamed cobalt (green.DEFAULT = #0255D5); prefer var(--swatch--cobalt) over green-* classes.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Statements Rule
rules.body: Serif is reserved for Display and Headline. A serif sub-head, serif body copy, or serif button label is off-system.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Label Rule
rules.body: Metadata (dates, categories, read time, section eyebrows) is uppercase Inter at label size with 0.017em tracking. Sentence-case metadata is a drift.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards, sections, and buttons are flat until the user touches them. Shadow is feedback, not decoration.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: No filter: drop-shadow() glows, no radial-gradient halos, no box-shadow used as a light source. The glow-3d / glow-border-n8n utilities are quarantined to specific service landing pages and must not spread.

dos: Do ground every surface in the ivory/oat/slate ramp and reserve clay for the single most important element in view (The One Voice Rule).
Do use Lora for Display and Headline only, and Inter for everything else.
Do set metadata as uppercase Inter at 0.875rem with 0.017em tracking.
Do convey elevation by stepping the neutral (ivory -> oat -> slate), keeping surfaces flat at rest.
Do keep motion short and eased: ~150ms for state changes, ~300ms for reveals, standard cubic-bezier easing.
Do build layouts that survive ES->EN expansion without truncation or reflow breakage.
Do keep buttons and cards on the 8px radius; step to 12-16px only for large editorial containers.
donts: Don't use the generic AI-startup kit: purple/blue gradients, glowing orbs, neon grids, dark hero drama.
Don't introduce glow, halo, or drop-shadow light effects as system styling; the existing glow-* utilities stay confined to their current landing pages.
Don't use animate-pulse, bounce easing, or attention-grabbing badge styling (the accented badge variant).
Don't put a drop shadow on a resting surface, or use pure white / pure black as a page or card ground.
Don't use the deprecated purple #623CEA, teal #46B1C9, or the green/blue Tailwind scales in new work.
Don't let two clay elements compete on one screen.
Don't set body copy or sub-heads in the serif.
